messages.subject: Question regarding digit.curves in gpagen
parts:
Hello Geomorph community, 

I have derived 21 equidistant semilandmarks along a curve using the digit.curves function with 2 fixed landmarks defining the start and end of the curve. When writing the gpagen function, will I need to list these 21 points as a matrix for the “curves=“ argument, or will gpagen automatically know these points are semilandmarks?   

All the best,
--
Sean G .Swaters

MA Student
Richard Frucht Memorial Conference Coordinator (VP Social & Communication)

messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Question regarding digit.curves in gpagen
parts:
Dear Sean,

you need to provide the matrix of definition of sliders through the "curves =" argument for GPA.

Best,

Antigoni
